passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:
To: All Employees
From: Derek Pham, IT Department
Date: March 3
Subject: Scheduled system maintenance

Dear colleagues,

The IT Department will upgrade the company's file servers this Saturday, March 8, from 10:00 P.M. until approximately 6:00 A.M. on Sunday. During this period, the shared drive, the internal e-mail system, and the expense-report portal will be unavailable.

Please save all of your work and log out of the network before leaving the office on Friday. No files will be deleted, but we recommend copying any important documents to your own computer by Friday at 6:00 P.M.

If you must access the system over the weekend for an urgent reason, please contact me at extension 4471 before Thursday so that we can make special arrangements.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Derek Pham

questions.q: Why did Mr. Pham write the e-mail?
options: To announce a temporary service interruption
To explain a change in office hours
questions.explain: Email thông báo 'IT Department will upgrade the company's file servers' và các hệ thống sẽ 'unavailable' trong khoảng thời gian cuối tuần, tức là thông báo gián đoạn dịch vụ tạm thời.

questions.q: What are employees who need weekend access asked to do?
options: Log in from home on Friday
questions.explain: Đoạn cuối: 'please contact me at extension 4471 before Thursday so that we can make special arrangements'. Các lựa chọn còn lại không được nhắc đến như một yêu cầu.

passages.title: Notice to Guests
passages.text:
NOTICE TO OUR GUESTS
Harborview Grand Hotel

In order to improve your stay, the hotel's rooftop swimming pool will be closed for renovation from April 12 to April 30. During this time, guests are welcome to use the indoor pool at our sister property, the Marina Suites, located two blocks away. A complimentary shuttle will depart from the main entrance every thirty minutes between 7:00 A.M. and 9:00 P.M. Please show your room key card to the driver.

questions.q: What are guests invited to do during the renovation?
options: Book a spa treatment at a discount
Request a refund for their stay
questions.explain: Thông báo nói khách có thể 'use the indoor pool at our sister property, the Marina Suites', tức là bơi ở khách sạn gần đó. Spa vẫn mở bình thường chứ không giảm giá.

questions.q: The word 'complimentary' in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: 'Complimentary shuttle' là xe đưa đón miễn phí, nên nghĩa gần nhất là 'free of charge'. 'Polite' chỉ là nghĩa khác (lịch sự) của compliment, không hợp ngữ cảnh.

options: By calling a representative after June 30

passages.title: Lakeview Business Journal
passages.text:
LAKEVIEW BUSINESS JOURNAL
NovaLink Opens Regional Office in Lakeview
By Priya Raman, staff writer

LAKEVIEW (June 5) — NovaLink Systems, a software company specializing in logistics tools, officially opened its new regional office in downtown Lakeview on Tuesday. The company, which is headquartered in Dunmore, chose Lakeview because of its large pool of graduates from local technical colleges.

The four-story office will initially house 120 employees, but company president Hannah Cole said the figure could double within three years. 'We were impressed by how many skilled engineers live here,' Ms. Cole said. 'Many of them were commuting two hours a day to jobs elsewhere.'

To attract local talent, NovaLink will host a job fair on June 21 at the Lakeview Convention Center. Positions in software development, customer support, and sales will be available. Mayor Ted Alvarez, who attended the opening ceremony, praised the project and said it would bring 'steady, well-paid jobs' to the city. Construction of the building was completed two months ahead of schedule.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: A company's relocation of its headquarters
The opening of a new company office
A change in local college programs
A city's plan to build a convention center
questions.explain: Tiêu đề và câu đầu cho biết NovaLink 'officially opened its new regional office'. Trụ sở chính vẫn ở Dunmore nên không phải chuyển trụ sở.

questions.q: What is NOT stated about the Lakeview office?
options: It may employ more people in the future.
It was completed earlier than planned.
It includes a cafeteria for employees.
questions.explain: Bài nêu 'four-story', số nhân viên 'could double' và xây xong 'two months ahead of schedule'. Căng-tin không hề được nhắc tới nên D là đáp án NOT stated.

questions.q: Why did NovaLink most likely choose Lakeview?
options: Rent is lower than in Dunmore.
Its main customers are located there.
questions.explain: Bài viết: chọn Lakeview 'because of its large pool of graduates' và bà Cole khen 'how many skilled engineers live here', tức là vì có nhiều lao động có trình độ ở gần.

passages.title: Online chat discussion
passages.text:
Sana Malik [9:12 A.M.]: Good morning, team. The projector in Hall B isn't working. The conference starts at 1:00 P.M.
Jorge Ruiz [9:14 A.M.]: Oh no. I thought the hotel's technician checked it yesterday.
Tom Becker [9:15 A.M.]: He did, but he said the cable might need replacing. I can bring the spare projector from our office.
Sana Malik [9:17 A.M.]: That would be great. How long will it take you to get here?
Tom Becker [9:18 A.M.]: About forty minutes with traffic. I'll need someone to sign me in at the front desk.
Jorge Ruiz [9:20 A.M.]: I'll tell the receptionist. Meanwhile, should I ask the hotel to set up the registration tables?
Sana Malik [9:21 A.M.]: Yes, please. Put them near the main entrance, not in the hallway.
Jorge Ruiz [9:22 A.M.]: Will do.
Tom Becker [9:22 A.M.]: Leaving now.

questions.q: What problem does Ms. Malik report?
questions.explain: Tin nhắn đầu tiên: 'The projector in Hall B isn't working.' Các vấn đề khác không được nhắc đến.

questions.q: At 9:22 A.M., what does Mr. Ruiz most likely mean when he writes 'Will do'?
options: He will move to the hallway.
He will bring the spare projector.
He will pick up Mr. Becker from the airport.
He will have the tables set up near the entrance.
questions.explain: Ngay trước đó Sana yêu cầu 'Put them near the main entrance', nên 'Will do' nghĩa là Jorge sẽ nhờ khách sạn kê bàn đăng ký gần cửa chính. Tom mới là người mang máy chiếu.

questions.q: What will Mr. Becker most likely do next?
options: Replace the cable in Hall B
Go to the hotel with another projector
Sign in the guests at the front desk
questions.explain: Tom nói 'I can bring the spare projector' và cuối cùng viết 'Leaving now', nên bước tiếp theo là mang máy chiếu dự phòng đến khách sạn.

passages.title: Customer review
passages.text:
★★★★☆  Great location, small rooms
Posted by Linda Garcia on September 14

I stayed at the Alder Street Inn for five nights while attending a trade show at the nearby exhibition hall. The location could not be better: the hall was a seven-minute walk, and there were several good restaurants on the same block. The front desk staff were extremely accommodating. When my flight was delayed, they held my room and even arranged a late meal for me.

My only complaint is the size of the room. It was clean and quiet, but there was barely enough space for my luggage and a desk. The Wi-Fi was also slow in the evenings, which made video calls difficult. The breakfast buffet, however, was excellent, and I would happily stay here again, especially if the hotel offered larger rooms for business travelers.

questions.q: Why did Ms. Garcia stay at the Alder Street Inn?
questions.explain: Câu đầu: 'while attending a trade show at the nearby exhibition hall', tức là đi dự hội chợ thương mại.

questions.q: What problem does Ms. Garcia mention?
questions.explain: Bà viết 'The Wi-Fi was also slow in the evenings'. Phòng được mô tả là 'clean and quiet' nên A và B sai; check-in không được nhắc tới.

questions.q: The word 'accommodating' in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: Nhân viên 'held my room and even arranged a late meal', cho thấy họ sẵn lòng giúp đỡ, nên 'accommodating' gần nghĩa với 'helpful'.

passages.title: Careers page
passages.text:
Careers at Pixelforge Studios
Junior Mobile Developer — Full-time, Austin office (hybrid)

Pixelforge Studios builds fitness and travel apps used by over two million people. We are looking for a Junior Mobile Developer to join our growing product team.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and test new features for our iOS and Android apps
- Work closely with designers to improve the user experience
- Participate in weekly code reviews

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
- At least one year of experience with Swift or Kotlin
- Strong communication skills

Previous professional experience in the travel industry is a plus but not required. We offer health insurance, three days of remote work per week, and a yearly learning budget of $1,500.

To apply, submit your résumé and a link to a sample project through our online form by October 10. Applications sent by e-mail will not be considered.

questions.q: What is required for the position?
options: Some experience with a mobile programming language
questions.explain: Yêu cầu ghi 'At least one year of experience with Swift or Kotlin', là ngôn ngữ lập trình di động. Kinh nghiệm ngành du lịch chỉ là 'a plus but not required'.

questions.q: What benefit is NOT mentioned in the posting?
questions.explain: Bài đăng nêu bảo hiểm y tế, ba ngày làm từ xa mỗi tuần và ngân sách học tập $1,500; nghỉ phép có lương không được nhắc đến.

questions.q: How should applicants apply?
questions.explain: Câu cuối: nộp hồ sơ 'through our online form'; đơn gửi qua e-mail 'will not be considered' nên A sai.

passages.title: Memo
passages.text:
MEMO
To: All Delivery Drivers, Northern Region
From: Carla Mendes, Operations Manager
Date: February 10
Re: New delivery confirmation procedure

Starting Monday, February 24, all drivers must use the new handheld scanners to confirm every delivery. The scanners will replace the paper signature forms that you currently carry. Each scanner records the recipient's signature, a photograph of the package at the door, and the exact time of delivery, and this information is sent automatically to our customer-tracking system.

Training sessions will be held at the Eastfield depot on February 17, 18, and 19. Each session lasts two hours, and you must attend one of them. Please sign up with your team supervisor by February 14. Drivers who cannot attend any of the sessions should speak with me directly so that we can arrange individual training.

We expect the new system to reduce customer complaints about missing packages and to speed up our end-of-day paperwork. If your scanner is damaged or lost, report it to your supervisor immediately; replacement units will be limited during the first month.

Thank you for helping us make this change smoothly.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To introduce a new way of confirming deliveries
To announce a change in delivery routes
To ask drivers to apply for supervisor positions
To report an increase in customer complaints
questions.explain: Memo thông báo từ ngày 24/2 tài xế 'must use the new handheld scanners to confirm every delivery', tức là quy trình xác nhận giao hàng mới.

questions.q: What will the scanners replace?
questions.explain: Câu thứ hai: 'The scanners will replace the paper signature forms'. Hệ thống theo dõi khách hàng vẫn được dùng để nhận dữ liệu từ máy quét.

questions.q: What are drivers asked to do by February 14?
options: Sign up for a training session
questions.explain: 'Please sign up with your team supervisor by February 14' là đăng ký một buổi tập huấn với giám sát viên.

questions.q: What is suggested about the scanners?
options: They are already used in other regions.
Extra units may be hard to get at first.
They were designed by company staff.
questions.explain: Câu 'replacement units will be limited during the first month' ngụ ý máy thay thế sẽ khó có trong thời gian đầu. Tập huấn là bắt buộc nên D sai.

questions.q: Which room will most likely suit Ms. Osei's needs?
options: A room at Fresh Table Café

questions.q: How much will Ms. Osei most likely pay for the room, not including catering?

questions.q: By when should the lunch order be placed?

questions.q: What information does Ms. Osei request that is NOT on the webpage?
questions.explain: Bà Osei hỏi về chỗ đậu xe cho khách ('whether there is parking available'), thông tin này không có trên trang web. Giá, chính sách hủy và Wi-Fi đều đã được nêu.

passages.title: E-mail from a customer
passages.text:
To: customerservice@hearthhome.example
From: Marcus Lindqvist
Date: November 4
Subject: Order #55231 — damaged item and late delivery

To whom it may concern,

I ordered a walnut bookshelf (Model B-210) from your online store on October 20. The website promised delivery within seven business days, but the shelf did not arrive until two days after that promise. When I unpacked it, I found a large crack along one of the side panels. I have attached photographs of the damage.

I have already cleared a space in my study for the shelf and would prefer a replacement rather than a refund. However, I will need it by November 20, when my family is visiting. Please let me know whether that is possible.

Sincerely,
Marcus Lindqvist

passages.title: Reply from the company
passages.text:
To: Marcus Lindqvist
From: Aisha Bello, Customer Care, Hearth & Home
Date: November 5
Subject: RE: Order #55231 — damaged item and late delivery

Dear Mr. Lindqvist,

Thank you for contacting us, and please accept our sincere apologies for the damaged shelf and the delay. Replacement bookshelves in the walnut finish are currently out of stock, and the next shipment is expected to reach our warehouse on November 18. Because of this, we cannot guarantee delivery before your deadline.

To make up for the inconvenience, we can offer you one of the following: (1) a full refund, with free pickup of the damaged shelf; or (2) a replacement in oak finish, which is in stock and can be shipped tomorrow, with a 25 percent discount on the original price. Please reply by November 7 to let us know which you prefer.

Sincerely,
Aisha Bello
Customer Care, Hearth & Home

questions.q: What problem does Mr. Lindqvist NOT mention?
options: The website gave a delivery estimate.
questions.explain: Ông phàn nàn về giao hàng trễ, vết nứt ở tấm bên và nhắc đến thời hạn giao trên website; ông không hề nói gửi nhầm mẫu (Model B-210 là mẫu ông đặt).

questions.q: How late was the delivery according to Mr. Lindqvist?
questions.explain: Ông viết kệ sách đến 'two days after that promise', tức trễ hai ngày so với cam kết.

questions.q: Why can't Hearth & Home guarantee a walnut replacement by November 20?
options: The warehouse is closed for the holiday.
questions.explain: Ms. Bello nói loại gỗ óc chó 'currently out of stock' và hàng mới chỉ về kho ngày 18/11, nên không thể đảm bảo giao trước hạn.

questions.q: The word 'guarantee' in the second e-mail, paragraph 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: 'We cannot guarantee delivery' nghĩa là không thể cam kết/hứa giao hàng trước hạn, nên 'promise' là từ gần nghĩa nhất.

questions.q: Which option would best allow Mr. Lindqvist to have a bookshelf by November 20?
questions.explain: Ông cần kệ trước 20/11. Bản gỗ óc chó chỉ về kho 18/11 (không chắc kịp), hoàn tiền thì không có kệ; bản gỗ sồi có sẵn và gửi được ngay ngày hôm sau.

passages.title: E-mail inquiry

questions.q: Why did Ms. Fischer write to the hotel?
options: To book a room for herself

questions.explain: Bà hỏi 'Could you send me a quote for the venue and the dinner', tức là xin báo giá cho sự kiện.

questions.q: Why most likely did Mr. Haddad NOT recommend the Crystal Ballroom?
options: It is too expensive for the budget.
It does not include a sound system.
questions.explain: Ngân sách địa điểm là $4,000 mà Crystal Ballroom giá $5,200, vượt ngân sách (và dư sức chứa cho 90 khách). Sảnh này đã gồm sân khấu và hệ thống âm thanh.

questions.q: How much deposit will Ms. Fischer need to pay?
questions.explain: Tổng tiền địa điểm là $3,900 (phòng $3,600 + sân khấu $300). Đặt cọc 20% của $3,900 là $780; $720 là 20% nếu quên tiền sân khấu.

questions.q: What is indicated about the out-of-town guests?
options: They must reserve rooms by January 31.
They will stay for two nights.
They will be charged $68 per night.
questions.explain: Trang web ghi giá nhóm $139/đêm đã gồm 'Complimentary breakfast'. Khách chỉ ở một đêm và $68 là giá gói tiệc, không phải giá phòng.

questions.q: At what time may Ms. Fischer's team start decorating on March 21?
questions.explain: Chương trình bắt đầu 7:00 P.M. (email thứ nhất); đội trang trí vào phòng 'three hours before your start time' (email thứ ba, trang web cũng ghi vậy), tức 4:00 P.M.

passages.title: Memo
passages.text:
MEMO
To: All Staff, Brightwave Software
From: Elena Vasquez, Chief Operating Officer
Date: August 4
Subject: Introduction of the Beacon project-management system

On September 2, Brightwave will replace its current task-tracking tools with Beacon, a single platform that combines project schedules, time sheets, and client communication. The change is intended to reduce duplicated work and to give every team a clear view of deadlines.

All employees are required to complete one training session before the launch date. Sessions are organized by department; please see the attached schedule. Employees who miss their assigned session must attend one of the make-up sessions listed there. After September 2, the old system will remain available in read-only mode for 30 days so that you can transfer your files.

Questions can be sent to the Beacon support team at beacon@brightwave.example.

passages.title: Beacon training schedule
passages.text:
Beacon Training Schedule
All sessions are held in the Training Room, 3rd floor. Each session lasts 90 minutes.

Department             Date      Time
Engineering            Aug 19    9:00 A.M.
Sales and Marketing    Aug 20    1:00 P.M.
Finance                Aug 21    10:30 A.M.
Customer Support       Aug 22    9:00 A.M.
Make-up session 1      Aug 27    1:00 P.M.
Make-up session 2      Aug 28    9:00 A.M.

Please bring a laptop. Seating is limited to 25 people per session. Anyone with a scheduling conflict should notify the training coordinator, Dennis Lim, at least three days before the session.

passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:
To: Dennis Lim
From: Yuki Sato
Date: August 16
Subject: Training session conflict

Hi Dennis,

I work in the Finance department and I am scheduled for the Beacon training on August 21. Unfortunately, I will be at a client's office that morning for our year-end audit meeting, and I cannot reschedule it. Would it be possible for me to attend one of the make-up sessions? I would prefer the afternoon of August 27, since I have a deadline on the morning of August 28.

Thanks for your help,
Yuki

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To announce a reduction in staff
To inform employees of a new software system
questions.explain: Memo thông báo từ ngày 2/9 công ty sẽ thay các công cụ cũ bằng Beacon, một nền tảng quản lý dự án mới.

questions.q: What is stated about the old system after September 2?
options: It will be used only by the Finance department.
It will be available in a limited way for 30 days.
questions.explain: 'The old system will remain available in read-only mode for 30 days': vẫn dùng được nhưng chỉ để xem trong 30 ngày, không bị xóa ngay.

questions.q: At what time does the Customer Support training end?
questions.explain: Customer Support bắt đầu lúc 9:00 A.M. và mỗi buổi kéo dài 90 phút, nên kết thúc lúc 10:30 A.M.

questions.q: Which session will Ms. Sato most likely attend?
questions.explain: Cô Sato xin học bù vào chiều 27/8; theo lịch, buổi chiều 27/8 lúc 1:00 P.M. là Make-up session 1.

questions.q: What is required in the schedule but NOT mentioned in the memo?
questions.explain: Lịch ghi 'Please bring a laptop', còn memo thì không. Việc bắt buộc tham dự, chia theo phòng ban và gửi câu hỏi qua e-mail đều đã có trong memo.

passages.title: Order confirmation
passages.text:

Customer: Penhallow Design Studio, 22 Mill Road, Brookfield

Item                          Qty    Price

passages.title: Delivery update
passages.text:
To: Penhallow Design Studio
From: Kestrel Office Supply Delivery Team
Date: June 13
Subject: Delivery update for order KOS-90417

Dear customer,

Your lamps were delivered on June 12. The freight portion of your order is now scheduled to arrive on Tuesday, June 17, between 1:00 P.M. and 5:00 P.M. This is one day later than originally estimated due to a shortage of drivers. Please note that the standing desks are heavy (about 40 kilograms each) and that our drivers deliver only to the ground-floor entrance. If you need the items carried upstairs, you may add our inside-delivery service for $60 by replying to this e-mail before 5:00 P.M. on June 16.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

passages.title: Customer reply
passages.text:
To: Kestrel Office Supply Delivery Team
From: Hugo Penhallow
Date: June 13
Subject: RE: Delivery update for order KOS-90417

Hello,

Thank you for the update. Our studio is on the second floor and there is no elevator, so we would like to add the inside-delivery service. Please charge it to the card used for the original order. Also, I will be out of the office on June 17 until 3:00 P.M., but my assistant, Mei Nakamura, will be here and can sign for the delivery. Could you let me know whether that is acceptable?

Regards,
Hugo Penhallow
Penhallow Design Studio

questions.q: What is the purpose of the delivery team's e-mail?
options: To notify a customer of a schedule change
questions.explain: Email thông báo phần hàng vận chuyển 'is now scheduled to arrive on June 17', trễ một ngày so với dự kiến ban đầu (16/6), tức là báo thay đổi lịch giao.

questions.q: What is indicated about the lamps?
options: They arrived before the other items.
They are too heavy for ground-floor delivery.
questions.explain: Đơn xác nhận nói đèn gửi riêng bằng bưu kiện và có thể đến sớm hơn; email cho biết đèn đã giao ngày 12/6, trước khi ghế và bàn (17/6) tới.

questions.q: How much will Penhallow Design Studio pay in total if Mr. Penhallow's request is approved?
questions.explain: Tổng ban đầu là $1,595 (hóa đơn); thêm dịch vụ khuân vác lên tầng $60 (email giao hàng) thì thành $1,655.

questions.q: What does Mr. Penhallow ask in his e-mail?
options: Whether the delivery can be made earlier
Whether the freight cost can be reduced
Whether a different address can be used
Whether his assistant can sign for the delivery
questions.explain: Cuối email: trợ lý Mei Nakamura 'can sign for the delivery. Could you let me know whether that is acceptable?', tức hỏi liệu trợ lý có được ký nhận hàng không.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the delivery on June 17?
options: It was chosen by Mr. Penhallow.
It will begin after the studio closes.
It overlaps with time Mr. Penhallow is away.
It was moved to the morning.
questions.explain: Khung giờ giao là 1:00–5:00 P.M. còn ông Penhallow vắng mặt đến 3:00 P.M., nên một phần khung giờ giao trùng với lúc ông không có mặt; vì vậy ông nhờ trợ lý ký nhận.
